name: AFRISTEM Global
summary: A national STEM platform: programme pages, a competition registration flow and a school dashboard, built for 840+ competing schools.
detail: AFRISTEM needed one place for five editions of the Nigerian STEM Championship, a Digital Science School and a partner programme. We built a fast marketing site with a registration flow that a school head can complete on a phone in a weak-signal area.

name: Chi-Tom Rapha Hospital & Maternity
summary: A healthcare site for a 24/7 hospital in Izzi, Ebonyi: departments, services, patient appointment scheduling and emergency contact front and centre.
detail: Patients arrive on a phone, often in distress, often on a slow connection. The build leads with the emergency number, keeps departments one tap away, and takes appointment requests without a login.

name: McGettrick Centre
summary: A community centre site built around programmes, facilities and enquiries — deployed on a KR8 subdomain while the client's own domain is finalised.
detail: A centre serving a local community needs its programme calendar and facilities legible at a glance, and a single way to enquire. Built and deployed, with a custom domain ready to switch on.

name: Native Delicacies
summary: A restaurant site built during outreach: menu, story, gallery and a WhatsApp order path. Built, never taken up. Available with your own name and content.
detail: A complete restaurant build — menu with categories, a story page, a photo gallery and a one-tap WhatsApp order. The build is finished; the brand is not applied yet.

name: City Fashion Stores
summary: A complete visual brand position for a retail fashion business on Old Enugu Road, Abakaliki: identity, advertising graphics and a social creative suite.
detail: One identity applied across shop signage, adverts and a rolling social calendar — so the brand reads the same whether a customer sees it on a banner or a phone. The work is credited to KR8 Digitals in association with Motion Verse.

name: Zoey Perfume
summary: Product-led launch creative for a fragrance brand: a full flyer system built on one photograph, one palette and a single call to action.
detail: Built to be read in under two seconds on a phone — the product range, the promise and the WhatsApp number in one vertical frame. Made with Motion Verse.

name: Abakaliki High School
summary: A school trip campaign — one poster carrying the destination, the dates, the fee, the departure point and the booking route.
detail: Parents needed five facts fast. Everything that would have become a WhatsApp question is on the artwork, which is why the enquiries that reached the school were already ready to book.

name: Ridwan Footwear
summary: Wholesale footwear advert built around the stock list: slides, corporate shoes and sneakers, priced to be read from across a market.
detail: A supplier's advert has one job — show the range and be reachable. The layout puts product categories in the buyer's order of decision, with the phone number where a thumb naturally lands.

name: Consistency Drill
summary: The 30-day consistency programme that every KR8 team member completes before training: a public gallery of participants, editions and progress.
detail: Every joiner spends thirty days in the Consistency Drill before thirty days of team training. The site is where that habit becomes visible — portraits, editions and a record of who finished.

name: KR8 Academy
summary: The tuition-free school: seven tracks, admissions, a student dashboard, certificates and public credential verification.
detail: A full academy product rather than a marketing page: applications, cohorts, attendance, XP, certificates rendered to PNG and PDF with a scannable verification code, and a public verify tool an employer can use.
